% GUC: bioseq.storage.compression.algorithm
\multirow[t]{4}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.compression.algorithm}} & \multirow[t]{4}{=}{enum} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{zstd}}\par(default) & 
Chooses the compression codec for newly created column-storage options. Use Zstandard when compiled in. This is the preferred build-time default. Changing the default does not rewrite existing table data.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{none} & Store column chunks without compression.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{pglz} & Use PostgreSQL's PGLZ codec. This is the default when neither optional codec is compiled in.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{lz4} & Use LZ4 when compiled in. This becomes the default when Zstandard is unavailable.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.storage.compression.level
\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.compression.level} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{3}}\par(default)\par $1\ldots 19$ & 
Sets the Zstandard compression level for new storage options. The current PGLZ and LZ4 paths do not use this level.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.storage.stripe.row_limit
\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.stripe.row_limit} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{150000}}\par(default)\par $1000\ldots 100000000$\par rows & 
Sets the maximum rows in a new table's column stripe. Existing table options and stored stripes are unchanged.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.storage.chunk_group.row_limit
\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.chunk_group.row_limit} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{10000}}\par(default)\par $1000\ldots 100000000$\par rows & 
Sets the maximum rows in a new table's chunk group. Chunk groups divide a stripe into smaller column-reading units.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.storage.dml.enabled
\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.dml.enabled}\par\textit{hidden}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{on}}\par(default) & 
Controls whether reads apply deleted-row masks. Hide rows that have been deleted or replaced. Keep this enabled for ordinary queries.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{off} & Bypass deletion-mask filtering. This is a diagnostic control, not a read-only mode.\\[4pt]
\midrule

\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.column_cache.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{on}}\par(default) & 
Controls the backend's decompressed column-chunk cache. Cache eligible decompressed buffers during scanning. Normal scan teardown clears this cache. It is distinct from the query-result cache.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{off} & Read and decompress without retaining buffers in this cache.\\[4pt]
\midrule

\nolinkurl{bioseq.column_cache.capacity_mb} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{200}}\par(default)\par $20\ldots 20000$\par MiB & 
Limits the decompressed column-chunk cache. Buffers in use remain protected, so this is not a limit on total backend memory.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.load.write_overlap.enabled
\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.load.write_overlap.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{off}}\par(default) & 
Controls overlap between input decoding and table writes during loading. Use the ordinary loading schedule.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{on} & Overlap decoding with writing through a bounded queue. The PostgreSQL backend still performs table writes.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.storage.sequence_shard.max_size_gib
\nolinkurl{bioseq.storage.sequence_shard.max_size_gib}\par\textit{superuser} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{1024}}\par(default)\par $0\ldots 2147483647$\par GiB & 
Sets the sequence-shard size limit. A positive limit must accommodate one complete sequence. Zero starts a new shard for each insertion. Existing sequences are not moved.\\[4pt]

% GUC: bioseq.scheduler.backend.max_concurrency
\nolinkurl{bioseq.scheduler.backend.max_concurrency}\par\textit{reload} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{0}}\par(default)\par $0\ldots 1024$ & 
Caps participating task slots in each backend. Zero uses the available CPU count. The participating caller counts toward the cap. This is not a cluster-wide worker quota.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.scheduler.pipeline.mode
\multirow[t]{3}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.scheduler.pipeline.mode}} & \multirow[t]{3}{=}{enum} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{task_parallel}}\par(default) & 
Chooses where the task scheduler may run work concurrently. Allow eligible parallel regions inside the pipeline as well as parallel dispatch. Input access, batch size and memory admission can still limit parallelism.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{single_thread} & Run dispatch and coarse pipeline work on the caller.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{parallel_dispatch} & Allow independent eligible dispatch jobs to overlap, without selecting internal task-parallel regions.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.scheduler.postgres_parallel.enabled
\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.scheduler.postgres_parallel.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{off}}\par(default) & 
Controls task concurrency inside a PostgreSQL parallel-worker process. Restrict that process to one task slot.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{on} & Allow it to use multiple task slots within the backend concurrency cap.\\[4pt]

\multirow[t]{4}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.chaining.algorithm}} & \multirow[t]{4}{=}{enum} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{simd_minimap2}\par code 1}\par(default) & 
Chooses how matching seed anchors become chains. Use the bounded SIMD batch policy. 
Its approximation need not reproduce scalar chains exactly. A valid selector does not make every hardware and 
input combination executable. Per search: \nolinkurl{chaining_algorithm}.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{scalar_minimap2}\par code 0 & Use scalar minimap2-style dynamic-programming chaining.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{range_minimum_query}\par code 2 & Use the range-minimum-query chainer instead of scanning the ordinary predecessor window.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{vulkan_tiled_dynamic_programming}\par code 3 & Use tiled GPU dynamic-programming chaining on a supported Vulkan route.\\[4pt]
\end{longtable}
\endgroup

\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_open_penalty} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{24}}\par(default)\par $0\ldots 127$ & 
Sets KSW2's second gap-opening penalty. Native BlockAligner uses only the first gap-penalty pair. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{gap_open2}.\\[4pt]

\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_extension_penalty} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{1}}\par(default)\par $0\ldots 127$ & 
Sets KSW2's second gap-extension penalty. Native BlockAligner does not use this second pair. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{gap_ext2}.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.aligner.scoring.ambiguous_base_penalty
\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.scoring.ambiguous_base_penalty} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{1}}\par(default)\par $0\ldots 127$ & 
Sets the alignment penalty for ambiguous symbols on paths that support them. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{sc_ambi}.\\[4pt]

\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.scoring.z_drop_threshold} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{400}}\par(default)\par $-1\ldots 1048576$ & 
Sets KSW2's Z-drop threshold or BlockAligner's X-drop threshold for end extensions. 
BlockAligner extensions require a nonnegative value. Per search: \nolinkurl{zdrop}.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.aligner.scoring.end_bonus
\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.scoring.end_bonus} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{-1}}\par(default)\par $-1\ldots 1048576$ & 
Sets KSW2's sequence-end bonus. Negative one disables the bonus. 
Native BlockAligner does not use it. Per search: \nolinkurl{end_bonus}.\\[4pt]

% GUC: bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.minimum_block_size
\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.minimum_block_size} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{32}}\par(default)\par $8\ldots 4096$ & 
Sets BlockAligner's minimum adaptive block size. After widening to the active SIMD lane count, 
block sizes must be powers of two and the minimum cannot exceed the maximum. Per search: \nolinkurl{block_min_size}.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.maximum_block_size
\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.maximum_block_size} & int & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{256}}\par(default)\par $8\ldots 16384$ & 
Sets BlockAligner's maximum adaptive block size. Its effective size must be a power 
of two and at least the effective minimum. Per search: \nolinkurl{block_max_size}.\\[4pt]
\midrule
% GUC: bioseq.aligner.base_alignment.algorithm
\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.base_alignment.algorithm}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{enum} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{block_aligner}\par code 1}\par(default) & 
Chooses the base-alignment implementation when requested results need this stage. 
Use adaptive block alignment with the first gap-penalty pair. Selecting an implementation does not itself 
request CIGAR or base-alignment output. Per search: \nolinkurl{base_alignment_algorithm}.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{ksw2}\par code 0 & Use KSW2 with its banded extension and two gap-penalty pairs.\\[4pt]

% GUC: bioseq.aligner.vulkan.enabled
\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.vulkan.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{on}}\par(default) & 
Permits execution of selected Vulkan algorithms. Allow supported GPU work. This does not select a GPU algorithm by itself. 
An explicit per-search true value also requests a standalone GPU prefilter in an eligible scan. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{vulkan_enabled}.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{off} & Disallow Vulkan execution. Explicit GPU requests fail instead of silently changing algorithms.\\[4pt]

Selects Vulkan seed-hit lookup. Do not select GPU seed lookup through this switch. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{vulkan_seed_hits_enabled}.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{on} & Request GPU seed lookup subject to the supported route and device requirements.\\[4pt]
\midrule

\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.vulkan.index_cache.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{on}}\par(default) & 
Controls reuse of GPU-resident minimizer-index uploads. Retain compatible device index data for reuse on a selected GPU seed route. 
Per search: \nolinkurl{vulkan_index_cache_enabled}.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{off} & Do not reuse uploads through this GPU index cache.\\[4pt]
\midrule

\multirow[t]{2}{=}{\nolinkurl{bioseq.aligner.vulkan.fused_frontend.enabled}} & \multirow[t]{2}{=}{bool} & {\bfseries \nolinkurl{off}}\par(default) & 
Selects the resident fused Vulkan frontend. Leave this frontend unselected.\\*
 &  & \nolinkurl{on} & Request fused device frontend work as part of a supported Vulkan execution route.\\[4pt]
\midrule
